candidates.audit_decision: All Claude ratings retained after independent review.

evidence.summary: Demonstrated ability to halt Naruto's movement with Shadow Imitation Technique until Nine-Tails Chakra Mode broke the hold.

candidates.name: Iroha Hyūga
candidates.audit_decision: All Claude ratings retained after independent review.

evidence.summary: Tracked the escapees' progress through the Thirty-Six Layer Self-Repairing Barrier incident and relayed it to the barrier team.

candidates.name: Raiga Kurosuki
candidates.audit_decision: All Claude ratings retained after independent review.

evidence.summary: Highly demonstrated: former Seven Ninja Swordsman and Anbu who fought Team 7 and allies, defeated Tenten, and overwhelmed Naruto, Lee and Neji until given curry; natural lightning lets him fight continuously without tiring.

Used Hiding in Mist Technique to blind targets and make them more vulnerable; served as Anbu tasked with finding infiltrating spies.
Water Release mist blanketing and rock avalanche served as battlefield control; Ranmaru acted as his eyes and ears in a mutual support arrangement.

candidates.name: Santa Yamanaka

Mind Body Switch Technique (full body exchange rather than consciousness-only transfer) and Sensing Technique used despite absent sight.

Capable sensor entrusted with guarding and monitoring Boruto and Kawaki; detected chakra moving within the Claw Marks and warned the group; located Boruto on Naruto's request.

Assisted in Kakashi's confrontation with Pain and served on the Island Turtle guard detail to keep Naruto confined.

Byakugan perception and chakra-pathway targeting; helped dispel genjutsu affecting protesters and monitored/reported threats.
